title: Apache Struts2 S2-012 OGNL Injection
description: A Struts2 2.3.13 application, vulnerable to S2-012 (CVE-2013-1965): the user action's redirect result contains ${name}, so a name submitted as %{...} is evaluated as an OGNL expression, which runs commands.
question: Exploit S2-012 to run commands on the Struts2 server and read /ctf/flag.
